messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: calculating physical activity energy expenditure with GGIR package
parts: At the moment there is no algorithm available to calculate physical activity energy expenditure in GGIR.

This is not correct. Several algorithms have been described in the literature to estimate energy expenditure from acceleration metrics that are facilitated with GGIR (I could list some of my own studies for example), but I intentionally did not include any of those algorithms in GGIR, because in my opinion estimating energy expenditure from accelerometer data should be discouraged.

It is something researchers did in the past in order to make data more comparable across sensor brands when each brand had its own magic secret way of calculating movement, but that problem has been largely addressed with raw accelerometry. The only reason we do studies nowadays to look for correlations with energy expenditure is to confirm that the acceleration metrics are still associated with energy expenditure as you would biologically expect.

Best,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
